webhooks.detail: Webhook endpoints receive real-time event pushes from Stripe account events; configurable via Dashboard or API.

evidence.quote: After you register a webhook endpoint, Stripe pushes real-time data to it when events happen in your Stripe account.

sandbox.detail: Test mode and sandboxes: simulate payments with test cards, no real money movement. Available with a Stripe account; page does not say 'free' explicitly.

evidence.quote: You can simulate payments and use test cards to test your integration without moving money.

rate_limits.summary: 100 req/s live mode, 25 req/s sandbox, per Stripe account; many endpoints 25 req/s

evidence.quote: In general, rate limits are measured in API requests per second, per Stripe account.
Stripe provides several SDKs and libraries to help you integrate with the Stripe APIs across different platforms and languages.
This repository contains OpenAPI specifications for Stripe's API.
